tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and window background. #F5F5F7 and #1C1C1E are the surfaces the Flux palettes were tuned for.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and secondary buttons on bg.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebars and recessed areas such as code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, toggles). At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and sidebar. Also the lockup wordmark ink (the Flux Mono inks).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary button fill, selection, active nav. The colour of the Tandem lead disc. By night the fill is 3.6:1 on bg but 2.9:1 on surface (Flux value kept); there the white label carries the button.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9.1:1 by day, 4.8:1 by night).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and highlighted words on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted panel behind accent-related content, such as the security callout.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring with a 2px offset. At least 6:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: assistant
tokens.usage: The colour of the Tandem follower disc, used for the assistant's own activity: thinking, reading or acting on a tab, speaking. Fills and dots only; by day it is 2:1 on bg, so pair it with a label.

tokens.name: on-assistant
tokens.usage: Text on an assistant fill.

tokens.name: assistant-text
tokens.usage: Assistant labels and status text on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: assistant-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an assistant activity row or badge.

tokens.name: mark-lead
tokens.usage: The Tandem mark's lead disc (you): #3B1FD1 by day, #6D55FF by night. Only for the mark and the app icon.

tokens.name: mark-follower
tokens.usage: The Tandem mark's follower disc (the assistant): #14C79A by day, #2FE0B2 by night. The same mint as `assistant`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bg and surface. Always with a word or icon, because it sits near the assistant mint.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on bg and surface (4.1:1 on sidebar by day).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors on bg and surface. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: flux-track-deep
tokens.usage: Flux palette (the brand pair carried into Tandem: lead = track deep, follower = knob start), track gradient start; the silhouette, at least 3:1 on its surface. The only colour palette for the website, README and favicons.

tokens.name: flux-track-bright
tokens.usage: Flux palette: Track gradient end.

tokens.name: flux-knob-start
tokens.usage: Flux palette: Knob gradient start; defines the knob edge against the ring.

tokens.name: flux-knob-end
tokens.usage: Flux palette: Knob gradient end; sits near the surface on purpose.

tokens.name: ember-track-deep
tokens.usage: Ember palette, track gradient start; the silhouette, at least 3:1 on its surface. Momentum. From the superseded Flux palette draft (reference only; current Dock icon finishes are Default/Anodized, Steel, Copper, Light, Dark, and Mono).

tokens.name: ember-track-bright
tokens.usage: Ember palette: Track gradient end.

tokens.name: ember-knob-start

tokens.name: ember-knob-end

styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or section headline, in muted.

styles.name: app-title2

styles.name: app-display
styles.usage: Proposed token for the 21 and 22pt literals (onboarding).

spacing.note: One 2px-based scale for app and web. The app uses 6, 10 and 14 often, so they stay as half steps. Snap the app's 9px literals to 8 or 10.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and the wordmark; compact row padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default padding in app panels and between grouped controls.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Row height padding in the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card gap in grids; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between a headline and its copy.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns; large panel padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

radius.note: Values from Theme.Radius in the app. In the app, panel, card, control and chip are capped by the window corner radius.

tokens.name: radius-tight
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.tight: focus outlines, tiny swatches, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.chip: chips, badges, tab favicons.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.control: app buttons, inputs, hover backgrounds; website inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.card: cards in the app; code blocks on the website.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.panel: sidebars and floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Theme.Radius.popover: popovers and menus; feature cards on the website.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: Website only: large callout panels and hero artwork.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Stadium shapes that echo the Flux track: website buttons, the assistant badge, status pills.

shadow.note: The app's most common shadow and the command palette shadow, softened for Day.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette and modal sheets.

opacity.note: Theme.Wash: the primary text colour at these opacities, used for chrome states.

tokens.name: wash-selection

tokens.name: wash-strong
